about_the_game:
「Ghost Deliverer」

「Ghost Deliverer」 is a Korean occult fantasy adventure game that borrows the top-view pixel graphic style.

  • KEA (Korean Exorcist Association)

From ancient times to the present, 'ghosts' are beings that threaten the peace and safety of mankind. Ghosts are always doing evil things, such as harassing living people or threatening their lives, from places that cannot be seen.

However, thanks to the activities of the secret organization, KEA (Korean Exorcist Association), composed of people with spiritual power, we are protected from evil ghosts and live peaceful lives.

  • The Girl Who Sees Ghosts, Hyesung

The player becomes Hyesung, a girl with spiritual powers influenced by her mother, who was a shaman.

Hyesung considers her powers a curse due to the death of her mother when she was young and the various incidents and accidents she has been involved in.

Then, by chance, she meets exorcists from KEA (Korean Exorcist Association) and realizes that her mother's death is related to the evil exorcist organization 'Lunacide'.

Will Hyesung be able to join forces with her colleagues from KEA (Korean Exorcist Association) to stop Lunacide's conspiracy and find out the truth about her mother's death?

  • Daily Lives and the Boundary

The story of this game progresses between the real world where people live their ordinary ‘Daily Lives’ and the ‘Boundary’ created by evil spirits with grudges.

The two worlds are clearly similar, but at the same time, there are differences. Also, although they are separate worlds, they are closely connected to each other.

Exorcise the evil spirits that are hiding in the boundary and threatening the safety of people, and protect everyone’s precious daily lives.

  • A Story about Virtuous and Vicious, and Life and Death

Were all evil spirits vicious from the beginning?

There are no evil souls from the beginning. Everyone is born to be happy, but they change because they are not understood. Wounds beget wounds, and that pain eventually transforms into evil.

We ask again at the intersection of life and death.

Were they really evil, or were they destined to be evil?

Explore the Boundary, understand the grudges and desires of demons, and ultimately help them ascend to heaven by saving them.

short_description: One day, A girl accidentally gets involved with the 'KEA (Korean Exorcist Association)' and the evil organization 'Lunacide'... Will be able to stop Lunacide's plot and be reborn as a proper exorcist?
